question_summary: Elevation discrepancy between Grading Plan C-201 and Sheet C-101 for site retaining wall at Placement Zone 2; resolved by field verification and survey benchmark correction.
proposed_solution: Use elevation shown in Sheet C-101; Grading Plan C-201 to be corrected by addendum; site retaining wall matches C-101 once survey benchmark is corrected.
routing_rationale: Civil Engineer leads earthwork and site grading design; Structural Engineer involvement secondary for retaining wall structural verification.
